data.name: Xuande
data.detailed_description:
This is an authentic ancient life simulator that combines role-playing, life simulation, and strategy management gameplay.

You will play as the ruler of a fictional ancient Chinese dynasty, living in the imperial palace and managing your vast empire.

No Pre-scripted Story - Completely Different Gameplay

The game features hundreds of characters with different identities, including inner and outer court ministers, eunuchs, local officials, palace maids, servants, and more.

They are all powered by AI large language models. All story events are autonomously decided by AI in real-time:

  • You can freely converse with them without using interfaces, but by issuing commands through an input box.

  • Characters have their own lives that run automatically. They socialize, form factions, inform on others, accuse each other, serve loyally, or engage in corruption.

  • Empire management is no longer just a game of numbers and probabilities. You need to decide not only what to do, but also consider how they will execute your decisions.

  • The game truly integrates imperial tactics and political strategy. Characters will read between the lines, employ rhetoric, and take actions based on survival pressure.

  • Attitudes revealed in your words may be captured by characters who will try to figure out your mindset.

  • Characters have complex event and relationship memory functions. Some things you may have forgotten, but they remain deeply buried in someone's heart and begin to take root.

  • Characters may loyally support you, or based on certain chains of cause and effect, develop murderous intent or launch rebellions against you.

  • Characters possess iterative thinking abilities and may exploit game rules to make changes not originally designed.

In summary, this is a game entirely driven by real-time interactions between you and AI characters. You can choose to devote all your energy to empire management and political intrigue, or ignore state affairs and focus solely on cultivating the Dao... Choose your preferred palace lifestyle. How long you can survive in this world composed of you and other AIs, and what your empire will become in your hands, we simply don't know.

Gameplay

The game will simulate many aspects of ancient life:

  • Morning court sessions, court deliberations, small council meetings

  • Summoning officials

  • Conferring titles and granting rewards

  • Issuing edicts for punishment or imprisonment

  • Free appointment and dismissal of officials

  • Freely composing imperial edicts

  • Reviewing memorials (written by NPCs themselves)

  • Freely selecting imperial meals

  • Touring and planting rare spiritual herbs in the Imperial Garden

  • Freely consulting materials or reading books

  • Practicing martial arts to strengthen body and health

  • Cultivating the Dao with the Imperial Preceptor

  • Watching songs, dances, and operas

  • ......

The empire in the game covers fifteen provincial-level regions and approximately over one hundred prefecture-level administrative districts. Players can view the entire empire on the Nine Provinces map sandbox. The main activity scenes of the game are concentrated within the imperial palace; this game does not provide other scenes outside the palace.

Technical Brief

This is a single-player game. All game content, including the AI large language model, runs entirely on the player's local device.

(No need to connect to online AI services)

data.short_description: The game focuses on an authentic simulation of ancient Chinese life. The main scenes are set in the imperial palace, where you will manage a vast empire. Except for you, all other characters are played by AI large language models, which will bring you a unique experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: i5-12400F
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i7-13700K
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4070/4070 Super/4070 Ti (12GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
